name: Multi-segment and Multi-stage Projected Tetrahedra
definition: A visualization approach that partitions datasets into multiple segments in space and divides the visualizing procedure into multiple stages in time to solve the time-consuming sorting problem and increase user cognition.
summary: Multi-segment and Multi-stage Projected Tetrahedra is a volume rendering technique that partitions datasets spatially and stages visualization temporally to enable parallel sorting and improve user cognition.
